resources.string: Live video, automatic live view, recent alerts
Tender for Frigate · connects directly to your Frigate NVR servers. Not affiliated with the Frigate project.
Enter the address of your Frigate NVR. Use the authenticated port (8971) when connecting from outside its network.
Change how the app connects to this server. Use the authenticated port (8971) when connecting from outside its network.
Add another Frigate server. Use the authenticated port (8971) when connecting from outside its network.
Fallback when not on home Wi-Fi
Credentials are stored encrypted on this device
Only from this app: nothing changes on the server.
No Frigate server answered at %1$s. Check the address, or add the port (for example :8971).
No Frigate server answered at %1$s. Check the address and port.
No new servers found. Enter the address below.
The main stream for large tiles on Wi-Fi, otherwise the lighter sub stream.
Always the sharpest picture. Uses the most data and battery.
Always the lighter stream, a bit less sharp. Opening a camera still switches to its own stream.
Every tile plays live video. Uses more data and battery.
A tile plays live video while its camera sees motion or an object, and a picture otherwise.
Tiles show a picture that refreshes every few seconds.
Otherwise tiles go live only on activity while on mobile data.
Shows unreviewed alerts of the last day at the top of Live.
Plays recent alerts as short looping clips. Turn off to show a still image.
